rules: Review every assigned whole record, including meaning, stance, priority, acceptable access, aliases, source treatments, required facets, retained distinctions, and all evidence against supplied source.
Review assigned relationship direction, type, target, rationale and pages. Inspect neighboring endpoints as context even if another reviewer owns their disposition.
Review every task question, subject linkage and every required-access facet independently for usefulness, answerability and correct target.
Reconcile each assigned source-first finding explicitly; a related label/page match is not sufficient. Preserve source distinctions and uncertainty.
Enumerate exact reviewed IDs with authored source-grounded decisions and detailed fixes. Report partial work honestly; no inferred complete flags or approvals from page coverage.

Cross-chapter subjects, spanning or fallback tasks, spanning relationships, global exclusions and uncertainties are lead-owned. Findings concerning them should propose a disposition to the lead without claiming their entity review.
Original draft remains immutable. Write new ledger files only under this reviewer output directory and restricted extractions under .source-only/independent-review-work/actual-draft/reviewer-007-012.
No candidate inputs/results, root docs/validation, task histories or unlisted files. Verify allowed input hashes before reading.
revision_reason: Parent-approved transfer of untouched whole single-chapter15–17 records and wholly internal dependencies to the existing candidate-unexposed reviewer; no completed coverage overwritten.
additional_review_instructions: Original registered draft remains immutable. Every added stable entity is reviewed whole; all field/evidence/facet/treatment/access and applicable historical requirement dispositions require source-grounded review.
Source-first phase1 ownership and coverage are unchanged. For added chapters record the exact pages now inspected during draft review, and do not claim this as a new independent pre-draft pass.
All spanning relationships/tasks, all original lead source-first findings, all exclusions/uncertainties, all crosschapter integration and final approvals remain lead-owned.
Preserve completed reviewer007–012 outputs byte-for-byte; write new chapter15–17 review outputs under reviewer-007-012-additional-015-017/.
